steward_gate.rule: The Main Steward must refresh live main, exact candidate head, required statuses, substantive review completion and unresolved findings immediately before guarded merge. A review still pending is not a completed review. Any substantive review arriving after merge creates a durable post-merge incident/FIX_ORDER rather than becoming historical noise.

external_enforcement.desired: GitHub branch protection or repository ruleset requiring the three exact-head platform contexts plus the Steward integration status where administratively available
external_enforcement.current_truth: Repository policy files define the required contract, while the single active Main Steward remains responsible for atomic review/race/expected-head enforcement unless external branch protection or ruleset evidence proves those controls are enforced by GitHub.
